newsitem.title: CHINA: Group forms for Agri Bank of China US$120 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Group forms for Agri Bank of China US$120 mln FRCD.

text.p: A syndicate group has formed for Agricultural Bank of China's Singapore branch US$120 million floating rate certificates of deposit issue due 2002, the arrangers said.

The five-year certificates were issued at par and reoffered at a fixed 99.875. They pay a coupon of 30 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate. With fees, the all-in return for participants is 33 basis points.
Arrangers, with US$35 million each, are Bayerische Landesbank's Hong Kong branch and Societe Generale Asia.

Co-arrangers, with US$3 million each, are Bank of China International (UK), Bear Stearns Asia, Daiwa Singapore, Development Bank of Singapore, Fuji International Finance (HK), HSBC Markets, Landesbank Hessen Thuringen Girozentrale, LTCB Asia, Oversea-Chinese Banking Corp, Sakura Finance Asia, Sanwa International Finance and United Overseas Bank.

Co-lead managers, with US$2 million each, are ABN AMRO Bank, BA Asia, Banca Nazionale del Lavoro's Hongkong branch, Banque Nationale de Paris's Hongkong branch, Banque Paribas, DKB Asia and Union Bank of Switzerland's Hongkong branch.
Signing is tentatively set for August 15 in Singapore. The payment date is August 28.
